title: [review] messaging.py:151: Duplicate message ID updates c
description: When a message is POSTed with an explicit id that already exists in _sent_order, the content in _sent is overwritten (line 150) but the id is not re-added to _sent_order (line 151-152 only appends if not present). This means 'updated' messages retain their original creation position rather than appearing at the end, which may cause confusion in ordered listings.
